items.title: Pilgrim Child with a Spinning Top
items.alt: A crouching child in an ochre doublet and grey breeches watches a wooden spinning top on a small earthen patch beside a loose cord.
items.description: A crouching child in an ochre doublet and grey breeches watches a wooden spinning top on a small earthen patch beside a loose cord. An original historical illustration for personal projects and classroom activities.

items.title: Pilgrim Child Tending a Goat
items.alt: An older child in blue and brown clothing stands beside a small horned goat near a low timber rail, holding a loose rope lead.
items.description: An older child in blue and brown clothing stands beside a small horned goat near a low timber rail, holding a loose rope lead. An original historical illustration for personal projects and classroom activities.

items.title: Pilgrim Fisher Mending a Net
items.alt: A seated man in a tan doublet and plain wool cap mends a small linen fishing net with a wooden shuttle beside a rope coil and barrel.
items.description: A seated man in a tan doublet and plain wool cap mends a small linen fishing net with a wooden shuttle beside a rope coil and barrel. An original historical illustration for personal projects and classroom activities.

items.title: Pilgrim Voyage Sailor with Rope
items.alt: A sailor in a plain linen shirt, dark breeches and wool cap carries a coiled hemp rope over one shoulder.
items.description: A sailor in a plain linen shirt, dark breeches and wool cap carries a coiled hemp rope over one shoulder. An original historical illustration for personal projects and classroom activities.

items.title: Pilgrim Traveler Packing a Sea Chest
items.alt: A kneeling adult in a russet doublet places folded linen into an open wooden sea chest beside a rolled wool blanket.
items.description: A kneeling adult in a russet doublet places folded linen into an open wooden sea chest beside a rolled wool blanket. An original historical illustration for personal projects and classroom activities.

items.title: Pilgrim Voyage Sailing Ship
items.alt: A complete early-seventeenth-century square-rigged wooden merchant sailing ship has pale sails, a raised stern, bowsprit and coherent rigging above a small bounded water ripple.
